Title: Gateio futures does not work with CCXT Pro

### Description

Hello! When I use 'defaultType' => 'swap' in the constructor parameters and then use the create_order_ws method, I get an open position on spot market instead of futures. Is this a bug? Thank you.

### Code

```
$config = [
    'apiKey' => $this->key,
    'secret' => $this->secret,
    'options' => [
        'defaultType' => 'swap' // for perpetual futures
    ],
];
$this->gateWs = new \ccxt\pro\gateio($config);

/* some other code*/

$data = yield $this->gateWs->create_order_ws(
    'XRP/USDT',
    'market',
    'buy',
    10,
    $this->tickers['XRP']
); // This opens an order on the spot market, not futures

```
